text: Generally speaking, depressants are drugs that can reduce the body's functioning in many areas. They lower blood pressure, reduce mental processing and slow motor and reaction response. There are several types of drugs that can cause a depressing effect on the body. As a matter of fact, the most common of these is alcohol. How does alcohol usually reduce the body's functioning?
